commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; DB="$HOME/agent-workspace/review/photomap-2026-09-12/app.db"; DB="$DB" python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(os.environ['DB']); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
photo_stats=c.execute("select count(*) n, sum(case when length(coalesce(description_blocks,''))>1000 then 1 else 0 end) over_1k, sum(case when length(coalesce(description_blocks,''))>3000 then 1 else 0 end) over_3k, sum(case when length(coalesce(description_blocks,''))>6000 then 1 else 0 end) over_6k from photo where status='approved'").fetchone()
place_stats=c.execute("select count(*) n, sum(case when length(coalesce(article_blocks,''))>1000 then 1 else 0 end) over_1k, sum(case when length(coalesce(article_blocks,''))>3000 then 1 else 0 end) over_3k, sum(case when length(coalesce(article_blocks,''))>6000 then 1 else 0 end) over_6k from place where status='published'").fetchone()
print('approved_photo_description_stats='+json.dumps(dict(photo_stats),ensure_ascii=False))
print('published_place_article_stats='+json.dumps(dict(place_stats),ensure_ascii=False))
rows=c.execute("select ph.id,ph.place_id,p.title,ph.caption,length(coalesce(ph.description_blocks,'')) chars from photo ph join place p on p.id=ph.place_id where ph.status='approved' order by chars desc limit 15").fetchall()
print('longest_photo_descriptions='+json.dumps([dict(r) for r in rows],ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
rows=c.execute("select id,title,length(coalesce(article_blocks,'')) chars,length(coalesce(description,'')) lead_chars from place where status='published' order by chars desc limit 15").fetchall()
print('longest_place_articles='+json.dumps([dict(r) for r in rows],ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
c.close()
PY
